assumptions: The exception for being otherwise directed by a police officer or traffic control signal is left out because that behaviour cannot be seen from vehicle tracks and the provided geometry.
The presence of a stop sign and an intersection is taken as given by the provided stop_zone and stop_line; the rule does not separately detect a stop sign or an intersection.
The driver's duty is evaluated from the tracked vehicle, so entity_name is vehicle.

A stop is interpreted as DWELL in stop_zone: continuously inside stop_zone for at least 1000 ms with max_speed 0.05, the DSL encoding for stopped/still; the statute states no minimum stop duration, so 1000 ms is assumed.

Stopping at the near side at the stop line is interpreted as the measured point being stopped in stop_zone, the last 10 metres before stop_line, rather than the measured point being exactly on stop_line.
The anchor is center because the line description states boxes represent vehicles viewed from above, their centre is the metric position, and bottom_center is the downstream AABB edge, not wheels.

Only the inbound crossing of stop_line, encoded as direction to_right for movement in +y from y<0.6 towards y>0.6, triggers the requirement; a vehicle that never crosses stop_line passes under the IMPLIES idiom.
within_ms is null because the statute states no maximum time between stopping and crossing.
raw_output.normalized_explanation: Every vehicle that crosses the marked STOP line inbound must first have stopped still for at least 1000 ms in the approach waiting zone before that crossing.

provenance.reason: The line description states boxes represent vehicles viewed from above and their centre is the metric position, while bottom_center is the downstream AABB edge, not wheels.

provenance.quote: shall stop at the near side of the intersection at a clearly marked stop line
provenance.reason: stop_zone is the provided approach-lane waiting zone in the last 10 metres before the marked STOP limit line.
stop_line is the provided marked STOP limit line across the inbound approach.
The line description maps the inbound approach from y<0.6 towards y>0.6, moving downwards in +y, to to_right.
The statute requires a stop but states no minimum stopped duration, so 1000 ms is an assumed observable minimum.

text: Unless otherwise directed by a police officer or traffic control signal, the driver of a vehicle approaching a stop sign at an intersection shall stop at the near side of the intersection at a clearly marked stop line.
